method_note: CASE 2026 (Shenyang, Aug 17-21, 2026) PaperCept program. Counted 89 technical oral sessions (Regular + Special Sessions, 508 papers), grouping numbered series (e.g. "Emerging Technology of Automation System" -> one track with its session count). Excluded: 3 Best Paper Award sessions, 20 workshop sessions, plenaries. Caveat: the 57 regular sessions carry broad generic titles (e.g. "Emerging Technology of Automation System", "Enabling Technology of Industrial Intelligence"), so they map mainly to automation/ai-ml; special-session titles carry most of the specific signal. Each session split equally across at most 2 keywords; weight = sessions mapped / 89. All counted sessions were mapped. Keywords below 0.02 omitted; listed weights sum to 0.932. deployable-structures: none found in the 89 counted CASE 2026 session titles or their paper titles (searched deploy/origami/fold/tensegrity/inflat/kirigami/extendable/boom; only software 'deployable' in abstracts).
